rtos.priority_evidence: All five direct calls to the two native task creation functions were decoded: 7/8/9 and 62/63. Slot 6 must still be checked at runtime.

memory.physical_ram_upper_bound_evidence: Original JZ4720 U-Boot SDRAM test starts at 0x80000000 and bounds each word against 0x81ffffff. This establishes the factory software RAM window; physical capacity was not measured and no SDRAM geometry loader was present.
memory.physical_sdram_bytes_basis: factory software memory-test range, not a hardware measurement

usb.controller_evidence: The actual native JZ4720 driver accesses MUSB FADDR/POWER/INDEX/TXMAXP/TXCSR/RXMAXP/RXCSR/RXCOUNT/FIFO/DMA register layout at 0xb3040000.
usb.cable_evidence: 0x8005bc48 returns !(GPIOB_PIN & 0x40000); USB window close consults the resulting 0x80 power flag at 0x80025258.
usb.cable_shared_power_caveat: The native query is also used by external-power/battery code. Its role as a dedicated VBUS signal and physical polarity require board testing.
usb.cdc_endpoint2_hardware: Independent JZ4720 board source chain: Qi Ben NanoNote manual identifies JZ4720; qi_lb60 enables USB_JZ4740; the selected Ingenic UDC driver exposes EP2 IN interrupt with maxpacket 64 and FIFO offset 0x28. BBK board traffic remains untested.

notification_endpoint.evidence: Qi Hardware Ben NanoNote JZ4720 actual board configuration and selected Ingenic UDC driver; not a JZ4740-only compatibility inference

primary_source_evidence.name: Ingenic UDC driver selected by qi_lb60

identity_evidence.package_note: The recovery folder is labelled V3.30. The selected 4720 kernel itself displays V3.2; no V3.30 identity is inferred.

validation.static: Exact raw/wrapper identity, RTOS/TCB/allocator/timer, exports, MUSB registers and clock control, low-active power GPIO, LCD descriptor and factory RAM-test bounds decoded independently from JZ4720 inputs.
validation.memory_evidence: Independent JZ4720 U-Boot factory memory-test limit; no JZ4740 SDRAM geometry reused.
validation.usb_cable: Native low-active PB18; shared external-power detection; physical board and CDC traffic untested.
validation.scope: verified means static binding and CRC verification only
